nodes.label: North Star Plan: 'Options You Can See' consolidated strategy
nodes.rationale: Consolidates 9 adversarially-scored strategies into one plan: india-fno wedge + prosumer-saas global expansion, engineered toward a $24-36M tuck-in exit.

nodes.label: India F&O wedge ('The 91% Club', free beachhead)
nodes.rationale: India is the free, near-zero-CAC credibility-and-data beachhead, NOT the ARR engine; charging the 91% who lose money while legally barred from promising profit is a willingness-to-pay paradox.

nodes.label: Global prosumer SaaS expansion (Plus $19 / Pro $39 / Power $59)
nodes.rationale: Real recurring dollars come from the global USD prosumer wallet (users already paying $50-150/mo across OptionStrat, Unusual Whales, TradingView); mirrors ranked strategy #1.

nodes.label: SEBI 91-93% F&O loss statistic (demand hook)
nodes.rationale: Government-sourced, un-fakeable demand hook: SEBI found 91-93% of F&O traders lose money, Rs 1.05 lakh crore in FY25; the india-fno path is built on it, making regulatory throttling counter-cyclical armor.

nodes.label: Disciplined monetization ladder (free forever -> $19/$39/$59, card-required trial, India Rs 399/799 as funnel)
nodes.rationale: Card-required 7-day trial (~31% vs ~9% opt-in conversion); India tier treated explicitly as top-of-funnel and dataset, never core ARR — the fix to the 'Rs 520 blended ARPU is fiction' flaw.

nodes.label: AI-as-teacher wired to conversion (never AI-as-oracle)
nodes.rationale: Bury the ~56% forecaster and 27-bot consensus as learning instruments; /api/explain teacher becomes the gated premium SKU instrumented on the North Star metric: AI-narration -> next paper trade within 24h.

nodes.label: Proprietary behavioral-data flywheel (how beginners learn options)
nodes.rationale: Every cone-drag, Greek tweak, paper trade and confusion point logged as training data; the un-clonable asset that earns a ~24x data-moat multiple instead of ~12x plain SaaS. UI is copyable; the dataset is not.

nodes.label: One lighthouse broker white-label (B2B2C)
nodes.rationale: Exactly ONE broker deal — the marquee logo that de-risks the exit; stacking multiple brokers on identical SEBI-compliance demand is cannibalistic double-counting the judges flagged.

nodes.label: Engineered tuck-in exit (Composer->SoFi / Sensibull->Zerodha pattern)
nodes.rationale: $2.5-3.5M ARR with proprietary dataset, dependent broker and clean compliance = $24-36M at 8-12x, ~$70M in the 24x data-moat case; floor is a $10-20M dataset+team tuck-in.
